title: Backrooms + Portal : seems like there could be some fun gameplay
author: shottycoin
selftext:
Found this Backrooms level model on sketchfab ([link](https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/backrooms-vr-room-baked-b3dc718ea39248feb0120f1c6171419d)), and inserted into pixelfork, just to vibe check if it can be nice combination. Horror + Portal mechanics.   


any thoughts?

comments.author: webdev-dreamer
comments.body: i wonder how vibe-coding levels/puzzles would be? that's the really creative part of these types of games right?

comments.author: AMadHammer
comments.body:
Glad you continued on this. 


Question: did you set up the lighting yourself? I am curious to what is the light type to accomplish this. I am trying to do it with godot.

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: I actually used 3d model of the level's lighting texture. attached the model's link on the post.

comments.author: Star_Petal_Arts
comments.body: Add a monster that you have to catch in the portal and cut up into pieces... then the pieces start chasing you and then you have to keep cutting them apart like a worm... until the thing is dead.

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: oh wow. it sounds so good. will try

replies.author: shottycoin
replies.body: it's AI game development platform. you can build your own games.
